Skewness in imbalanced datasets affects Automatic Text Classification (ATC), leading to classifier bias toward the majority classes.
This work examines undersampling methods to mitigate such bias in Small and Large Language Model (SLMs and LLMs) classifiers.

Based on the limitations found in existing solutions, we propose two novel undersampling methods inspired by state-of-the-art Instance Selection techniques, relying on calibrated confidences and semantic difficulty estimates.
